input: Find STEM, science, coding, academic, cooking and enrichment summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Brevard, Pisgah Forest, Rosman, Cedar Mountain, Lake Toxaway and Sapphire, NC (Transylvania County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Brevard Pisgah Forest science STEM summer camp 2026

candidates.name: Pisgah Astronomical Research Institute (PARI)
candidates.note: 2026 residential camps for middle and high school students cover astronomy, physics, engineering and cryptography.

candidates.name: Brevard College
candidates.note: Campus Adventures enrichment program ran July 20–24, 2026, for rising first through seventh graders.

candidates.name: Blue Ridge Community College
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Academy offered hands-on career enrichment camps across its Transylvania and Henderson campuses.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Transylvania County 4-H
candidates.note: 2025 Summer Fun offered supervised hands-on activities and learning experiences for youth.

candidates.name: Pisgah Collective
candidates.note: Offered summer 2026 outdoor, child-centered learning and play programming.

candidates.name: The Cindy Platt Boys & Girls Club of Transylvania County
candidates.note: Eight-week summer programming includes reading instruction and enrichment to prevent summer learning loss.

candidates.name: Transylvania County Library
candidates.note: 2025 summer reading and in-person enrichment included science magic, theater and children's activities.

candidates.name: Green River Preserve
candidates.note: 2027 enrollment announced for nature-centered residential camps and teen wilderness and cultural-learning expeditions.
